translations.EN: I appreciate you listening. It's hard to make plans while we're trying to survive.
translations.TL: Salamat sa pakikinig. Mahirap magplano habang sinusubukan nating mabuhay.

translations.EN: Thanks for understanding. It's hard to think about relationships with everything going on.
translations.TL: Salamat sa pag-unawa. Mahirap isipin ang relasyon sa dami ng nangyayari ngayon.

translations.EN: Thanks. I'd rather leave it there for now.
translations.TL: Salamat. Mas gusto kong hanggang dito na lang muna.

translations.EN: Thanks for the compliment, but I thought we were already together.
translations.TL: Salamat sa papuri, pero akala ko tayo na.

translations.EN: That's kind of you to ask. I don't have a clear answer right now.
translations.TL: Mabait mong itanong iyan. Wala pa akong malinaw na sagot sa ngayon.

translations.EN: Thanks for saying that. I can't give you a clear answer about relationships right now.
translations.TL: Salamat sa sinabi mo. Hindi ko pa masagot nang malinaw ang tungkol sa relasyon ngayon.

translations.EN: Thanks, but I'd rather keep that personal.
translations.TL: Salamat, pero mas gusto kong sarilinin muna iyan.

translations.EN: I thought we were already together.
I haven't really thought about dating. Right now, I'm focused on surviving.
translations.TL: Hindi ko pa talaga naiisip ang makipag-date. Mas iniisip ko muna kung paano makakaligtas.

translations.EN: Honestly, I haven't had much room to think about relationships lately.
translations.TL: Sa totoo lang, wala akong gaanong panahon para isipin ang tungkol sa relasyon ngayon.

translations.EN: I'd rather not get into that. There's too much going on right now.
translations.TL: Mas gusto kong huwag munang pag-usapan iyan. Marami pa tayong pinagdaraanan ngayon.
